title: studio → pipelines: a batch run reached a terminal status
description: Subject evt.studio.<session_id>.run_finished (stream EVT), Nats-Msg-Id <run_id>:finished, written to studio's outbox in the transaction that makes a run with a batch_id terminal: the projector applying the runner's status, and every status studio decides itself (cancelled, created failed for no live host, created cancelled for a stopped batch, lease lost twice). pipelines_service consumes it (durable `pipelines-runs` on EVT, filter `evt.studio.>`) and resumes the waiting thread with it whatever the outcome; one that finds no thread waiting on this run (already resumed from a studio.runs.create reply) is acked and dropped.

row.description: the row; from API 1.15 0 = the director's chat thread (its turns' ask runs)

idempotency_key.description: the key the run was created under: names the thread (batch:row), row attempt, node, loop and branch

answer.description: from API 1.14: the run's answer (a text workflow), as evt.run.status carried it; absent otherwise
